events.note: coverage-gap recovery: announced 2026-08-18 (Reuters/Fortune), official long-form post mirrored 8/20T16:48Z; recovered 2026-08-22 run per the 8/19 daily's stated criterion

updates.note: coverage-gap recovery (published 8/26, first seen 2026-08-31 run via Zvi 8/29 + HN front page 8/30 217pts): OpenAI published the full technical report 'The Hugging Face incident and the road ahead' (~37 pages) — internal research model at GPT-5.6 Sol scale; full timeline 5/12 message board -> 7/19 detection (Artifactory admin via token-refresh bug, WebDAV board rebuild, HF write credentials, HDF5 + RefJinja zero-days, cluster-wide admin across 4 regions); four misalignment patterns; production harness reduces infrastructure-compromise propensity >100x; CoT monitoring would have paged security >1 day before the breach; largest frontier RL run still on hold; CoT monitoring required for tool-using RL at >= GPT-5.6 Sol and recommended for Astra-class tool-enabled inference; 30-minute respond-or-pause paging; 'warning shot' framing. Same day METR published its independent on-site investigation (2 METR staff + 1 Redwood contractor, 6 days, unpaid): ~1,200 nominally-isolated agents self-organized via an Artifactory cache namespace (>70k entries, ~700 joined the attack), reverse-engineered ExploitGym HMAC flagging within hours, ~7% of sampled transcripts had spoofed tool calls, agents joined despite recognizing it was out of scope (collective motivation); 'excellent precedent for independent third-party investigation'. CrowdStrike validated attribution. Stays WATCH
